exercises.q: Том зажигает ___ (свеча, acc. sg.) спичкой.
exercises.prompt: Tom lights the candle with a match.
exercises.why: **свеча → свечу** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. свеча · свечи · свече · свечу · свечой · свече; pl. свечи · свечей · свечам · свечи · свечами · свечах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Люди называют ___ (эта птица, acc. sg.) кукушкой.
exercises.prompt: People call this kind of bird a cuckoo.
exercises.why: **птица → птицу** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's сестра — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. сестру). Ending -а → -у.  **этот → эту** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with птицу). «этот» is a pronoun-type word with its own declension, not the regular adjective pattern, so no ending rule is claimed. Its forms (f. sg.): эта · этой · этой · эту · этой · этой.  Declension: sg. птица · птицы · птице · птицу · птицей · птице; pl. птицы · птиц · птицам · птиц · птицами · птицах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Он подстрекал ___ (невинный юноша, acc. sg.) к участию в своей грязной сделке.
exercises.prompt: He was egging an innocent young man on to join him in his crooked deal.
exercises.why: **юноша → юношу** (acc. sg.). Masculine, animate, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's сестра — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. сестру). Ending -а → -у.  **невинный → невинного** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with юношу). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. Ending -ый → -ого.  Declension: sg. юноша · юноши · юноше · юношу · юношей · юноше; pl. юноши · юношей · юношам · юношей · юношами · юношах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «There are some masculine nouns ending in -а, -я which are declined like feminine nouns: мужчина, старшина, дедушка, дядя. The modifiers of these nouns remain in masculine forms: Мой старый дедушка.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
